title: VDBE Btree payload and constant-expression value materialization

scope.rationale: One Mem materialization unit owns bounded Btree payload copies/local borrowing and active-profile scalar AST literal folding used by VDBE and planner consumers.
excluded_responsibilities: STAT4-only valueFromFunction and ValueNewStat4Ctx behavior is inactive in the pinned profile.
Connect exact Btree cursor operations and vtab RHS resolver production callers.
Pinned-C trace and independent review remain open.

external_source_responsibilities: Exact AST or Btree cursor ownership supplied by caller
dependencies.caller_closure: Every assigned source body is complete behind typed ownership boundaries; remaining public/compiler callers are explicit blockers.

inputs: Valid exact BtCursor plus payload range, or scalar Expr plus encoding and affinity
outputs: Owned or ephemeral Mem and exact SQLite result
contracts.ownership: Btree local bytes are ephemeral; overflow/literals are connection-domain Mem allocations transferred to caller.
contracts.state_and_results: Outputs start null. Bounds/corruption/NOMEM propagate. CAST, unary signs, literals, blobs, true/false, affinity, and encoding follow active non-STAT4 source branches.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Btree operation callbacks run under caller-held Btree/database synchronization; expression folding has no callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Payload failure releases partial dynamic state; expression failure leaves output null and frees temporary values.

representation_differences: Typed Btree operations replace direct C calls while preserving order/results.
STAT4-only function folding and UnpackedRecord allocation are inactive-profile exclusions.

internal_observations: Mem flags, encoding, bytes, and scalar representation
continuation after rejected or non-foldable input
oracle.normalization: Compare exact primary result, Mem type/value/bytes, and owned versus ephemeral state.

assurance.oom: Allocation failure publishes NOMEM, null output where required, and preserves releasable Mem ownership.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Btree synchronization and I/O are caller/typed-operation responsibilities; literal folding performs no I/O.
assurance.malformed_input: Record bounds, maximum allocation, absent AST children/tokens, and unsupported expressions fail without fabricated values.
assurance.continuation: Successful values remain caller-owned; failed temporary values are released.
assurance.performance: Local payloads remain zero-copy; overflow copies once; literal folding is linear in token/payload size.

integration.native_call_path: VDBE/planner callers invoke typed materialization helpers; focused native tests execute every active-profile family.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No substitute source behavior remains inside the assigned helper bodies.

independent_review.notes: Requires pinned-C trace, caller integration, assurance, and independent review.
